versions.subject: Domain Trust Discovery rule (T1482)
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine: 'dsquery'
selection2:
    CommandLine: '-filter'
selection3:
    CommandLine: '(objectClass=trustedDomain)'
selection4:
    CommandLine: 'nltest'
selection5:
    CommandLine: 'domain_trusts'
condition: selection1 and selection2 and selection3 or selection4 and selection5

versions.subject: Update win_dsquery_domain_trust_discovery.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
  - Image|endswith: '\dsquery.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '-filter'
        - 'trustedDomain'
  - Image|endswith: '\nltest.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'domain_trusts'
condition: selection
